rubric.policy: Every current exact-version action is represented once. Atom-backed rows use the frozen atom registry; atomless rows use composition-owned handler-equivalent effects. A row's verdict follows its effect contract, so an atomless action whose contract is physical or acquisitive is recorded as physical-without-atom / acquisition-without-atom residual debt rather than as nonphysical.
